title: A Causal Energy Prior for Learning Directed Acyclic Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2611.33225v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bayesian learning of directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) has long relied on non- or weakly informative priors, on the assumption that the information needed for an informative one is rarely available. In genetics and systems biology, annotation databases now make it possible to assemble a prior DAG before learning from data. Existing informative priors are local: they score a DAG arc by arc and cannot encode how interventions propagate along its paths. Thus, we propose the local-global energy prior (LGE), a Gibbs distribution over DAGs whose energy combines a local divergence from the prior DAG, the Structural Hamming Distance, and a causal one, the Structural Intervention Distance. We derive rules to calibrate its decay and the weight of the two divergences from the prior DAG alone. translated_title: 一种用于学习有向无环图的因果能量先验
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯有向无环图（DAG）学习长期以来依赖于无信息或弱信息先验，其假设是有信息先验所需的信息很少可用。在遗传学和系统生物学中，注释数据库如今使得在从数据学习之前构建先验DAG成为可能。现有的有信息先验是局部的：它们逐条弧地对DAG进行评分，无法编码干预如何沿其路径传播。因此，我们提出了局部-全局能量先验（LGE），这是一种DAG上的吉布斯分布，其能量结合了与先验DAG的局部差异（结构汉明距离）和因果差异（结构干预距离）。我们推导了仅从先验DAG出发校准其衰减速度以及两种差异权重的规则。当先验DAG部分不正确时，我们量化了有多少先验概率质量保留在真实DAG上，以及需要多少数据才能推翻该先验。在仿真实验中，LGE……
tldr: 提出了局部-全局能量先验（LGE），通过结合局部结构差异（结构汉明距离）与因果差异（结构干预距离）构建DAG上的吉布斯分布，使贝叶斯DAG学习能够编码干预沿路径传播的因果信息，并量化了数据在先验部分错误时对先验的修正能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes the local-global energy prior (LGE), a Gibbs distribution over DAGs combining local structural divergence (Structural Hamming Distance) with causal divergence (Structural Intervention Distance), enabling Bayesian DAG learning to encode how interventions propagate along paths and quantifying how much data overturns a partially incorrect prior.
